systems.name: Alphabets (True Alphabets)
systems.description: Isme Vowels (स्वर) aur Consonants (व्यंजन) dono ke liye alag aur barabar ke letters hote hain. Yeh left-to-right likhi jaati hain.

systems.name: Abugidas / Alphasyllabaries (Segmental Scripts)
systems.description: Isme main unit ek consonant hota hai jisme default "a" sound juda hota hai. Baaki vowels ko dikhane ke liye matraon (diacritics) ka use kiya jata hai jo consonant ke upar, neeche, aage ya peeche lagti hain.

systems.name: Abjads (Consonant-based Scripts)
systems.description: Isme sirf Consonants likhe jaate hain. Vowels ko context ke hisab se khud samajhna padta hai ya fir optionally chote dots/marks (diacritics) se dikhaya jata hai. Yeh majorly Right-to-Left (daayein se baayein) likhi jaati hain.

systems.name: 4. Logographic & Syllabic Systems (Block / Character Based)
systems.description: Isme alphabets nahi hote. Ek single character ya toh ek poore concept/word ko represent karta hai (Logogram) ya fir ek poore syllable/sound-block ko (Syllabary).

scripts.name: Kana System (Japanese Syllabary)
scripts.note: Japanese me Hanzi (Kanji) ke sath do phonetic scripts mix hoti hain: Hiragana aur Katakana.

scripts.name: Hangul (Korean Featural Alphabet)
scripts.note: Yeh dikhne me Chinese character block jaisa lagta hai, par actually yeh duniya ka sabse scientific system hai jahan alag-alag letters ko ek square block me assemble karke syllable banaya jata hai.

systems.name: 5. Ge'ez / Ethiopic (Syllabic-Abugida Hybrid)
systems.description: Isme har ek character ek consonant + vowel ka combination hota hai, jise ek alag unit ke roop me hi likha jata hai.
